The FDA encourages you to prepare for severe storms, such as tornadoes, hurricanes, and blizzards, and other emergencies that can cause power outages, flooding, or road and business closures. Make an emergency plan and take steps to safely store water, food, medications, and other medical supplies for yourself and your pets so you are prepared during and after an emergency.
For questions about specific drug products, call the FDA general number:
1-888-INFO-FDA
(
1-888-463-6332
).
